name: time
title: world.time
lead: Holds the sky at a time (ticks, or "sunrise", "day", "noon", "sunset", "night", "midnight"), or asks a function each tick, `s` seconds after the call. With no argument: the time of day now, 0 to 23999.
signature: world.time((at: number | TimeName | (s: number) -> number | TimeName) -> ()) → & (() -> number)

usedIn.quote: `world.time("sunset")` holds the sky at sunset: low light makes the roof
world.time("day")                         -- the sky stays there; see "the time of day"
world.time(function(s) return s * 20 end) -- asked each tick; s is seconds since this call
